steps.name: jkp_ctry
steps.sql: select excntry, eom, count(*) as n, sum(me) as me_tot, sum(case when be_me is not null then me*be_me end)/nullif(sum(case when be_me is not null then me end),0) as bm_agg, sum(case when ni_me is not null then me*ni_me end)/nullif(sum(case when ni_me is not null then me end),0) as ep_agg, sum(case when div12m_me is not null then me*div12m_me end)/nullif(sum(case when div12m_me is not null then me end),0) as dp_agg, sum(case when ret_exc_lead1m is not null then me*ret_exc_lead1m end)/nullif(sum(case when ret_exc_lead1m is not null then me end),0) as ret_lead_vw from contrib_global_factor.global_factor where common=1 and primary_sec=1 and obs_main=1 and exch_main=1 and me>0 and eom>='1980-01-01' group by excntry, eom

steps.name: ibes_ctry
steps.sql: with idc as (select ticker, max(country) as country from ibes.idsum group by ticker) select i.country, cast(date_trunc('month', s.statpers) as date) as m, count(*) as nfirm, sum(s.numup) as up, sum(s.numdown) as dn, sum(s.numest) as nest from ibes.statsum_epsint s join idc i on s.ticker=i.ticker where s.fpi='1' and s.measure='EPS' and s.statpers>='1985-01-01' group by 1,2 union all select 'US_FILE' as country, cast(date_trunc('month', statpers) as date) as m, count(*), sum(numup), sum(numdown), sum(numest) from ibes.statsum_epsus where fpi='1' and measure='EPS' and statpers>='1985-01-01' group by 2
